api_key.label: API key
api_key.help: Optional. A key for the "Shipment Tracking - Unified" API from developer.dhl.com. Without it Parcel Master reads the tracking of dhl.de.

prefer.label: Preferred way
prefer.help: Only matters if an API key is entered. If the preferred way fails, the other one is tried.

live.label: Live tracking on the delivery day
live.help: An experiment, off by default: so far DHL does not serve the built-in browser. Switched on, Parcel Master opens DHL's page in the browser for parcels with a postal code that are out for delivery and reads how many stops are left; every five minutes once the delivery window has begun, every minute from five stops on. After a failed visit the browser rests for half an hour.

default_postal_code.label: Your postal code
default_postal_code.help: Pre-filled as the recipient's postal code for incoming parcels. It goes into the "Open at DHL" link and to the API, if you use it.

postal_code.label: Recipient postal code
postal_code.help: Optional. Goes into the "Open at DHL" link, so DHL shows delivery details there, and to the API, if you use it.
